content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A useful data model makes identity, relationships, optional fields, dates, and special values explicit. API-friendly structures favor stable names, predictable types, documented compatibility rules, and a balance between nesting and references.

content_blocks.title: What you will cover
content_blocks.text: This lesson explicitly addresses: JSON's lack of a dedicated date or time type. ISO 8601-style textual representations. Date-only versus date-time values.; Time zones and UTC. Unix timestamps and their numeric limitations. Consistent date and time contracts.. Treat each as part of a workflow: define what the data should mean, represent it consistently, and test how the chosen implementation interprets it.

content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: Date and Time Representation
content_blocks.expected_output: The date and timestamp are strings under a documented ISO 8601-style contract; JSON itself has no dedicated date type.
